content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy all the time. Research shows muscle growth is similar across a wide rep range (about 5-30 reps) as long as your sets are taken close to failure (0-3 reps left in the tank) and you do enough weekly volume. Lighter loads work for size, but heavier loads (1-6 reps) are better for building max strength. 💪

Your bench goal is 100 kg, so you should do both. Keep your main bench work heavy and add moderate-rep sets (8-12) on accessories for hypertrophy. Ain't nothin' but a peanut!
